description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveJobCategoryController' used in the OrangeHRM system. It handles pre-render logic for saving or editing a job category, setting up the appropriate Vue component based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveJobCategoryController
classes.description: A controller class extending AbstractVueController, managing the pre-render setup for creating or editing a job category, depending on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering. Checks for an 'id' attribute in the request; if present, sets up an edit component with the job category ID; if not, sets up a new save component.
